programme.title: Złombol
programme.desc: Polski rajd Złombol obejmuje trasę 2500 km. Należy go pokonać samochodem, który ze względu na swój stan nadaje się do zezłomowania. 12 lat temu wydarzenie to nie było popularne; wzięła w nim udział tylko pojedyncza ekipa w jednym pojeździe. 29 czerwca 2019 roku natomiast w Katowicach stawiło się już 460 zespołów w autach jeszcze z czasów komunistycznych. Do zgłoszenia się zachęca z pewnością nie tylko charytatywny aspekt całej akcji - pokonanie takiej odległości maszyną, która może rozlecieć się w dowolnym etapie, budzi też emocje. Kolejnymi utrudnieniami dla uczestników są również presja czasu i upał.

programme.title: Koleją przez świat 6
Chris Tarrant's Extreme Railway
programme.desc: W szóstym sezonie serii Chris Tarrant ponownie spotka się z widzami na trasie prowadzącej do najciekawszych zakątków świata, do których bez problemu dojedzie się pociągiem. Chris przemierzy m.in. trasę z Budapesztu do Transylwanii zafascynowany tajemnicą hrabiego Drakuli, zahaczy o Istambuł oraz Turcję, odwiedzi także Irlandię, którą przemierzy w sześć dni, poruszając się wyłącznie koleją. Prowadzący uda się też do Kenii, gdzie znajduje się linia będąca ciekawym projektem kolejowym epoki kolonialnej.

programme.title: 13 posterunek 2
programme.desc: Trzynasty posterunek jest tym razem pokazany w scenerii przedwojennego kina niemego. Na komisariacie zjawia się starszy biznesmen. Mężczyzna składa Kasi ciekawą ofertę pracy. Proponuje jej, aby została jego osobistą asystentką. Zachęca ja wysoką pensją w wysokości ośmiu tysięcy złotych. Czarek dostrzega w przyszłym pracodawcy swojej narzeczonej rywala. Nie chce pozwolić na to, żeby Kasia zgodziła się na jego propozycję. Za wszelką cenę stara się ją nakłonić do odrzucenia oferty. Jest w stanie zrobić wszystko, żeby tylko jego narzeczona nie podpisała umowy.

programme.title: Hot Roads - Najniebezpieczniejsze drogi świata 2
Hot Roads - The World's Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Twórcy serii przemierzają najbardziej niebezpieczne drogi świata. Podróżowanie nimi kryje śmiertelne zagrożenie. Nagrodą są niezapomniane wrażenia, zapierające dech w piersiach widoki i przeżycie ekscytującej przygody. Czeka ich przeprawa przez pustynię, śnieg i lód. Trafiają w środek dżungli, przedzierają się przez górskie szczyty i wzdłuż rzeki. Odwiedzają wszystkie kontynenty o różnych porach roku. Nie jest im straszny szlak przemytników w Senegalu, syberyjskie pustkowia i zatłoczona autostrada nad Adriatykiem. Towarzyszami są mieszkańcy, którzy znają zdradzieckie pułapki bezdroży. Niebezpieczeństwo czyha na każdym kilometrze. Wielu przypłaciło życiem taką eskapadę.

programme.title: Sędziowie
programme.desc: Kulisy pracy polskich sędziów piłkarskich. Będziemy mieli wyjątkową okazję nie tylko zobaczyć, ale również usłyszeć ich w trakcie meczów. Poznamy także inne perspektywy tego zawodu.

programme.title: Twardzielki
programme.desc: Opowieść o wybitnych sportsmenkach, łamiących stereotypy dotyczące kobiet. Widzowie poznają dziesięć poruszających historii, m.in. Joanny Jędrzejczyk, Ewy Piątkowskiej oraz Gabrieli Kuzawińskiej.

programme.title: Miasta rytm
programme.desc: Historyk sztuki Jerzy Majewski podróżuje po polskich miastach. Zajrzy m.in. do Olsztyna i Gdyni. W każdym miejscu poszuka najpiękniejszych architektonicznie budynków i zapozna się z lokalną historią.

programme.title: Survivalowa rodzina
programme.desc: Łukasz Tulej zabiera rodziny na weekendową wyprawę i pokazuje, jak w atrakcyjny i niedrogi sposób można spędzić czas z bliskimi. Widzowie zobaczą m.in. walkę o przetrwanie na świeżym powietrzu.

programme.title: 13 posterunek 2
programme.desc: Strajk, zainicjowany przez Czarka, trwa, a pieczę nad jego przebiegiem sprawuje profesjonalny organizator protestów - Roman. Rozszerzyła się jednak liczba postulatów: policjanci żądają teraz przywrócenia do służby emerytowanego Stępnia, podwyżki płac i wolnej środy. Tymczasem Roman, ku zdumieniu policjantów, organizuje na posterunku kolejny bunt - prostytutek, które domagają się zmiany swojego opiekuna. W końcu komendant uświadamia sobie, że sprawy wymykają się spod kontroli - postanawia więc rozpocząć negocjacje.

programme.title: 13 posterunek 2
programme.desc: Nadchodzi wiosna - pora zakochanych. Czarek dochodzi do wniosku, że najwyższy czas pogodzić się z Kasią. Kupuje bilety do kina i zaprasza dziewczynę na kolację przy świecach. Sprawy komplikują się z chwilą, kiedy na posterunku pojawia się naukowiec, który zgłasza kradzież teczki z dokumentacją jego najnowszego wynalazku - eliksiru zapewniającego niewidzialność. Cezary daje poszkodowanemu do zrozumienia, że uważa go za osobę niespełna rozumu. Zdenerwowany naukowiec wypija swoją miksturę i staje się niewidzialny. W ramach zemsty zaczyna płatać Cezaremu niezwykle złośliwe figle.

Żużel: PGE Ekstraliga - rewanżowy mecz finałowy fazy play-off: Betard Sparta Wrocław - PRES Grupa Deweloperska Toruń
programme.desc: Panowanie Motoru Lublin w Ekstralidze trwało trzy lata i dobiegło końca w 2025 roku za sprawą toruńskich Aniołów. Ekipa ta jest na dobrej drodze, by też zapisać się złotymi zgłoskami w annałach rodzimego żużla. Pierwsza część finałowego dwumeczu pomiędzy PRES-em Toruń i Spartą Wrocław rozpoczęła się z dwugodzinnym opóźnieniem z powodu opadów deszczu. Obie drużyny zrekompensowały jednak kibicom oczekiwanie i zafundowały im świetne widowisko. Ostatecznie gospodarze wygrali 55:35 i do stolicy Dolnego Śląska pojadą dopełnić dzieła. Szóste mistrzostwo Polski w historii klubu z Miasta Pierników jest więc na wyciągnięcie ręki Patryka Dudka i jego kolegów. W meczu na Motoarenie zawiódł zwłaszcza Maciej Janowski, który zdobył dla Sparty tylko 4 punkty. Doświadczony zawodnik w wywiadach nie ukrywał, że jego drużyna jest w bardzo trudnej sytuacji przed rewanżem. Ma jednak powody, by wierzyć w sukces swojej misji. W sezonie zasadniczym Wrocławianie ograli Torunian na Stadionie Olimpijskim 52:38. Ponadto w 2026 roku pozostają niepokonani przed własną publicznością. Przy znakomitej dyspozycji wszystkich żużlowców i odrobinie szczęścia są więc w stanie odwrócić losy finałowej rywalizacji i po pięcioletniej przerwie wrócić na ekstraligowy tron.

Żużel: PGE Ekstraliga - rewanżowy mecz finałowy fazy play-off: Betard Sparta Wrocław - PRES Grupa Deweloperska Toruń
programme.desc: Panowanie Motoru Lublin w Ekstralidze trwało trzy lata i dobiegło końca w 2025 roku za sprawą toruńskich Aniołów. Ekipa ta jest na dobrej drodze, by też zapisać się złotymi zgłoskami w annałach rodzimego żużla. Pierwsza część finałowego dwumeczu pomiędzy PRES-em Toruń i Spartą Wrocław rozpoczęła się z dwugodzinnym opóźnieniem z powodu opadów deszczu. Obie drużyny zrekompensowały jednak kibicom oczekiwanie i zafundowały im świetne widowisko. Ostatecznie gospodarze wygrali 55:35 i do stolicy Dolnego Śląska pojadą dopełnić dzieła. Szóste mistrzostwo Polski w historii klubu z Miasta Pierników jest więc na wyciągnięcie ręki Patryka Dudka i jego kolegów. W meczu na Motoarenie zawiódł zwłaszcza Maciej Janowski, który zdobył dla Sparty tylko 4 punkty. Doświadczony zawodnik w wywiadach nie ukrywał, że jego drużyna jest w bardzo trudnej sytuacji przed rewanżem. Ma jednak powody, by wierzyć w sukces swojej misji. W sezonie zasadniczym Wrocławianie ograli Torunian na Stadionie Olimpijskim 52:38. Ponadto w 2026 roku pozostają niepokonani przed własną publicznością. Przy znakomitej dyspozycji wszystkich żużlowców i odrobinie szczęścia są więc w stanie odwrócić losy finałowej rywalizacji i po pięcioletniej przerwie wrócić na ekstraligowy tron.

programme.desc: Abril de 1945.

programme.title: Sobre a Noite Passada
programme.desc: Dois casais fazem a viagem do bar para o quarto e são testados no mundo real.

programme.desc: Dois miúdos encontram um carro da polícia abandonado e decidem aprender a guiá-lo. Mas quando o corrupto xerife da cidade decide reavê-lo, os três envolvem-se numa corrida eletrizante onde vale tudo.

programme.title: Collide - A Alta Velocidade
programme.desc: Depois de um assalto correr mal, Casey Stein é obrigado a fugir de um gangue cruel, que tudo fará para recuperar os seus bens valiosos. Sem opções e para proteger a namorada, Casey envolve-se numa louca perseguição pelas autoestradas de Munique.

programme.title: Misteriosa Obsessão
programme.desc: Telly Paretta é uma mulher que luta por superar a perda do seu filho de oito anos. Um dia, seu psicoterapeuta diz-lhe que o seu filho não é mais que um produto da sua imaginação.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: John Rambo, hesita em acompanhar o velho amigo Coronel Trautman às linhas soviéticas no Afeganistão. Mas acabará por seguir, numa missão não-oficial de resgate na sequência da captura de Trautman.

programme.title: Duna
programme.desc: O planeta Dune guarda o mistério supremo: é o portal da especiaria melange, a chave para controlar o universo, pela qual clãs se digladiam no espaço.

programme.title: D-Tox
programme.desc: Jake Malloy, agente do FBI, foi testemunha da morte de algum dos seus companheiros, às mãos de um assassino de polícias. Quando este mata a sua namorada, Jake fica fora de si.

programme.title: Um homem furioso
programme.desc: H é um homem frio e misterioso, que trabalha para uma companhia responsável por transportar milhões de dólares todas as semanas em Los Angeles. Mas quando ele e o colega são alvos de uma tentativa de roubo, a sua verdadeira motivação é revelada...

programme.title: Ladrão e Polícia
programme.desc: Miles acaba de roubar um valioso diamante. Pouco antes de ser apanhado pela polícia consegue escondê-lo.

programme.title: Alta Pedrada
programme.desc: O preguiçoso e maconheiro Dale Denton (Seth Rogen) só tem um motivo para visitar seu traficante Saul Silver (James Franco), igualmente preguiçoso: comprar maconha, mais especificamente, um novo tipo, chamado Pineapple Express.

programme.title: Inferno

programme.title: Ex machina
programme.desc: Num retiro de montanha, Caleb é desafiado a interagir com o exemplar mais perfeito de inteligência artificial: uma rapariga robot.

programme.title: Em Defesa de Sua Majestade
programme.desc: Quando o pai de Chon é assassinado por um rebelde chinês que foge para Inglaterra, Chon e Roy decidem partir para Londres em busca de vingança.

programme.title: Reservation Road - Traídos pelo Destino
programme.desc: Uma história forte e humana sobre raiva, vingança e coragem, este filme leva-nos por uma intensa jornada que acompanha dois pais cujas famílias e vidas convergem na sequência de uma noite fatídica.

programme.title: Os Croods
programme.desc: Comédia e aventura pré-histórica que acompanha a primeira família do mundo na viagem das suas vidas logo que foi destruída a caverna que os protegia de todos os perigos.

programme.title: Para Além do Horizonte
programme.desc: Chirs e Annie não conseguiram superar a morte dos seus dois filhos ocorrida num acidente de viação. Quatro anos depois Chris também morre e descobre que o Céu existe e que é um grande lugar.

programme.title: Psico II
programme.desc: Vinte e dois anos depois do famoso homicídio de Marion Crane, Norman Bater é considerado são e é libertado, regressando ao seu motel dilapidado. Mas quando os homicídios recomeçam, Norman percebe que uma velha amiga aguarda o seu regresso, a mãe!

programme.title: Oficina do Diabo
programme.desc: Neste thriller sinistro, um ator pede a uma demonóloga para ajudá-lo a conseguir um papel, e o seu fim de semana juntos irrompe em violência ritual.

programme.title: Os Bad Boys
programme.desc: Um lote de heroína avaliada em cerca de 100 milhões de dólares é roubado do próprio depósito da polícia. O caso será encarregue aos agentes Burnett e Lowery, uma dupla muito peculiar pelos métodos que utilizam.

programme.title: Fúria
programme.desc: Abril de 1945. Os Aliados fazem a investida final no teatro europeu de guerra. Wardaddy, um sargento endurecido pela batalha, comanda um tanque Sherman e uma equipa de cinco homens numa missão mortal, atrás das linhas do inimigo.

programme.title: A Volta Ao Mundo Em 80 Dias
programme.desc: Uma versão do clássico de 1872, em que Passepartout é um ladrão chinês que recupera um buda de jade roubado à sua aldeia Natal, que ele terá de levar de volta com a maior brevidade possível.

programme.title: Coragem Debaixo de Fogo
programme.desc: Em 1991, após a Guerra do Golfo, Nathaniel Serling tenta obter provas que atestem o facto de Karen Emma Walden - oficial médica - merecer ser a primeira mulher a ganhar a Medalha de Honra.

programme.title: A Rapariga Dinamarquesa
programme.desc: História de amor inspirada na vida do casal dinamarquês, Lili Elbe e Gerda Wegener. O casamento e o trabalho de ambos ganha um novo sentido, à medida que vivem a arrebatadora viagem de Lili como a primeira transgénero. Filme vencedor de um Oscar® em 2016.

programme.title: Ladrão e Polícia
programme.desc: Um ladrão de joias escondeu um diamante roubado num edifício abandonado, antes de ser preso. Agora, descobre que o edifício é uma esquadra de Polícia de alta segurança. Disfarçado de detetive, torna-se num dos mais respeitados polícias da esquadra.

programme.title: Triplo Nove
programme.desc: Um gangue de criminosos e polícias corruptos planeia a morte de um oficial da Polícia, de modo a poderem realizar o maior golpe de sempre na cidade.

programme.title: O Carro da Polícia
programme.desc: Dois miúdos encontram um carro da polícia abandonado e decidem aprender a guiá-lo. Mas quando o corrupto xerife da cidade decide reavê-lo, os três envolvem-se numa corrida eletrizante onde vale tudo.

programme.title: D-tox
programme.desc: Jake Malloy, agente do FBI, persegue há muito um serial-killer que já matou nove polícias. O assassino contra-ataca e mata a noiva de Malloy e um amigo dele. Devastado, Malloy acaba internado numa clínica, mas não tarda a que os pacientes comecem a morrer...

programme.title: Chovem Almôndegas
programme.desc: A última invenção de Flint Lockwood é um sucesso: ele faz chover comida do céu! Mas as coisas começam a correr mal quando, em vez de deliciosos hambúrgueres com queijo, começam a chover almôndegas gigantes, a alta velocidade, que ameaçam tudo e todos...

programme.title: Confiança
programme.desc: A vida de Jake Vig pode depender do que não sabe. Este elegante jogador acaba de roubar milhares de dólares ao intocável Lionel Dolby. No entanto, quando Lionel e outro membro da equipa aparecem mortos, descobre-se que Lionel não é um homem qualquer.

programme.title: Psico III
programme.desc: Norman Bates apaixona-se por uma freira que esteve hospedada no Motel - o que deixa a sua "mãe" ciumenta - juntamente com um viajante e um jornalista curioso.

programme.title: A Troca
programme.desc: Los Angeles, 1928. Christine Collins é uma mãe solteira cujo filho desaparece sem deixar rasto. Meses depois, a polícia comunica-lhe que encontrou a criança mas, assim que o vê, Christine sabe que não é o filho dela.

programme.title: Misteriosa Obsessão
programme.desc: Telly Paretta é uma mulher que luta por superar a perda do seu filho de oito anos. Um dia, seu psicoterapeuta diz-lhe que o seu filho não é mais que um produto da sua imaginação.

programme.title: Dragão Vermelho
programme.desc: Will Graham é o agente do FBI que capturou Hannibal 'Cannibal' Lecter. Reformado, aceita ajudar numa investigação para capturar outro serial killer. A ajudá-lo nesta tarefa está Hannibal Lecter ,com comentários que o agente terá de decifrar.

programme.title: Fúria
programme.desc: Abril de 1945. Os Aliados fazem a investida final no teatro europeu de guerra. Wardaddy, um sargento endurecido pela batalha, comanda um tanque Sherman e uma equipa de cinco homens numa missão mortal, atrás das linhas do inimigo.

programme.title: Os Bad Boys
programme.desc: Burnett e Lowrey, polícias de Miami, têm de encontrar 100 milhões de dólares de heroína, roubada de um armazém da Polícia. Numa corrida contra o tempo, os detetives seguem a pista da única testemunha do caso, Julie Mott, e de Fouchet, um super ladrão.

programme.title: O Último Vermeer
programme.desc: Um soldado e membro da resistência holandesa investiga arte roubada na sequência da Segunda Guerra Mundial, incluindo um Vermeer vendido aos nazis por um famoso falsificador.

programme.title: A Troca
programme.desc: Los Angeles, 1928. Christine Collins é uma mãe solteira cujo filho desaparece sem deixar rasto. Meses depois, a polícia comunica-lhe que encontrou a criança mas, assim que o vê, Christine sabe que não é o filho dela.

programme.title: Um Homem Furioso
programme.desc: «H» é um homem frio e misterioso, que trabalha para uma companhia responsável por transportar milhões de dólares todas as semanas em Los Angeles. Mas quando ele e o colega são alvos de uma tentativa de roubo, a sua verdadeira motivação é revelada...

programme.title: Boyhood: Momentos de Uma Vida
programme.desc: Gravado ao longo de 12 anos, com o mesmo elenco, este projeto acompanha a vida do jovem Mason, dos seis aos 18 anos. Um miúdo como tantos outros que, aos poucos, emerge e segue o seu próprio caminho. Vencedor do Oscar® para Melhor Atriz Secundária em 2015.

programme.title: Na Linha de Fogo
programme.desc: Frank Horrigan, agente dos Serviços Secretos, é perseguido pela culpa de não ter conseguido evitar a morte de Kennedy, nos anos 60. Quando um assassino lunático lhe liga, a ameaçar de morte o atual Presidente dos EUA, Frank faz tudo para o proteger.

programme.title: Cães Danados
programme.desc: Joe Cabot (Lawrence Tierney), um experiente criminoso, reuniu seis bandidos para um grande roubo de diamantes, mas estes seis homens não sabem nada um sobre os outros e cada um utiliza uma cor como codinome.

programme.title: Passageiros
programme.desc: Uma nave espacial, com destino a uma colónia distante, tem um problema nas câmaras de sono e dois passageiros acordam, 90 anos antes da chegada ao destino. Ameaçados pelo iminente colapso da nave, tentam descobrir o porquê de terem acordado.

programme.title: Em Defesa de Sua Majestade
programme.desc: Quando o pai de Chon é assassinado por um rebelde chinês que foge para Inglaterra, Chon e Roy decidem partir para Londres em busca de vingança.

programme.title: Moto Gp: Marele Premiu Al Indoneziei
Pistruiatul 3 - Insurectia
programme.desc: Inainte de 23 august 1944, Pistruiatul participa la actiuni de pregatire a insurectiei, arunca manifeste deasupra orasului si incurca actiunile Sigurantei dezvaluindu-le informatii false.

programme.title: Connect
programme.desc: Emisiunea Connect își propune să prezinte săptămânal cele mai noi și interesante gadgeturi, de la cele mai cunoscute telefoane, laptopuri, wearables, aplicații și jocuri, la cele mai inedite proiecte care țin capetele de afiș ale presei de tehnologie din toată lumea.

programme.title: Sănătate cu stil
programme.desc: Prezentatoarea emisiunii aduce în atenţia telespectatorilor o serie întreagă de afecţiuni, cu care se confruntă tot mai mulţi români, şi oferă cele mai bune soluţii şi remedii pentru acestea, cu ajutorul celor mai buni medici din România. Telespectatorii vor afla şi cum pot avea grija cel mai bine de sănătatea lor, cum se pot hrăni sănătos, ce beneficii aduce mişcarea în viaţa lor, cum pot trata cel mai bine afecţiuni de care le este teamă sau ruşine să vorbească, dar şi cum îşi pot asigura o stare de bine cu ajutorul leacurilor din natură, al plantelor care pot face adevărate miracole pentru sănătatea lor.

programme.title: Life & Style cu Maria Andrei
programme.desc: Emisiunea le propune telespectatorilor să redescopere destinații bine cunoscute, dar și rute alternative, să cunoască oameni deosebiți și să le afle poveștile, rețetele gastronomice și produsele locale premiate. Maria Andrei mai aduce în atenția publicului știri pertinente și autentice cu ajutorul unor specialiști respectați, și îi ajută să fie la curent cu ultimele tendințe în domeniul life & style.

programme.title: De ce are vulpea coadă?
programme.desc: Un cuplu bucurestean pleaca in concediu impreuna cu baietelul lor de 6 ani, Gabi, la parintii sotului, intr-un sat de munte. Are loc si un incident cu o vulpe si un curcan.

programme.title: Schimb de mame
programme.desc: Emisiunea "Schimb de mame" aduce în prim plan experienţele inedite trăite de soțiile-mame care au curajul să își schimbe viaţa pentru șapte zile. În fiecare săptămînă, două soții-mame vor face "schimb de vieți", vor avea o familie, prieteni și o slujbă complet noi, într-o localitate și o casa cu totul necunoscute. La final, protagoniștii se vor întâlni pentru a-și împărtăși experienţele trăite în răstimpul celor șapte zile și vor fi premiați.

programme.title: Elisa

programme.desc:
Frumoasa Elisa Scalzi, dama de companie
a contesei Ristori, se îndrăgosteşte de fiul acesteia, Fabrizio. Din

programme.title: Black Phone 2
programme.desc: Four years after a serial killer prowled the streets of North Denver, posing as a magician to lure unsuspecting children into the back of his van, teenager Finney tries to adjust to a normal life. However, the lethal Grabber returns, and is bent on revenge. Horror thriller, starring Ethan Hawke and Mason Thames.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends travel to a remote woodland cabin, hoping one of them can conquer her drug addiction by going cold turkey. They uncover a mysterious book that, when read, unleashes demonic forces that possess the living and transform them into bloodthirsty zombies. Horror remake, starring Jane Levy and Shiloh Fernandez.

programme.title: Evil Dead Rise
programme.desc: Guitar technician Beth abandons life on tour to visit her estranged sister Ellie and three children, Bridget, Danny and Kassie. A 5.5 magnitude earthquake rocks the city, causing structural failures in the basement that expose an old bank vault and a copy of the Naturom Demonto. Horror, starring Alyssa Sutherland.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: A bank robber is bitten by a vampire, spelling trouble for his partners in crime, who find themselves trapped in their hideout with a bloodsucking terror. Horror sequel, starring Robert Patrick, Bo Hopkins, Duane Whitaker, Muse Watson and Tiffani-Amber Thiessen.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Massachusetts doctor Louis Creed moves to a small Maine town with his wife Rachel, their kids, Ellie and Gage, and Church, the cat. While exploring the local woods, Ellie stumbles across a funeral procession of children taking a dead dog to a cemetery. Neighbour Jud Crandall warns the Creeds that the woods are dangerous, as they soon discover for themselves via the dark power of the local burial ground. Horror based on the Stephen King novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Revenge
programme.desc: Some films are best served cold, so wrap up and join us as we dive into our favourite revenge movies - from new hits to Oscar-winning classics. We hope you're ready for action.

programme.title: Wolf Man
programme.desc: After a family barricade themselves inside their remote farmhouse when a creature attacks, a father slowly transforms into something unrecognisable. Werewolf horror from The Invisible Man director Leigh Whannell, starring Christopher Abbott, Julia Garner, Matilda Firth and Sam Jaeger.

programme.title: It
programme.desc: In the summer of 1989, a group of bullied kids band together to destroy a shape-shifting monster, which disguises itself as a clown and preys on the children of their small New England town. Part one of a two-part Horror based on the Stephen King novel, starring Bill Skarsgard, Jaeden Lieberher and Sophia Lillis.

programme.title: Five Nights At Freddy's 2
programme.desc: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Mike and Vanessa are pulled back into a terrifying series of events. Horror sequel, starring Josh Hutcherson and Elizabeth Lail.

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: After African American photographer Chris and his white girlfriend Rose visit her wealthy parents, he suspects there's more to the locals than meets the eye. Oscar-winning psychological thriller written and directed by Jordan Peele (Us), starring Daniel Kaluuya, Allison Williams, Bradley Whitford and Caleb Landry Jones.

programme.title: The Bride!
programme.desc: In 1930s Chicago, maverick scientist Dr Euphronius gives life to a murdered woman, sparking romance, police interest and radical change. Writer/director Maggie Gyllenhaal's horror based on The Bride of Frankenstein, starring Jessie Buckley, Christian Bale and Annette Bening.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront. Supernatural mystery drama, starring Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson and Elliot Cowan.

programme.title: The Shining
programme.desc: A writer takes a caretaking job at a remote mountain hotel. It has closed for the winter, and he has been hired to get the place ready for the next season. But evil spirits haunting its corridors destroy his sanity, causing the unhinged author to rampage through the hotel and terrorise his wife and young son. Stanley Kubrick's horror, based on the Stephen King novel, with Jack Nicholson, Shelley Duvall, Danny Lloyd and Scatman Crothers.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Four decades ago, Michael Myers terrorised the town of Haddonfield, Illinois and went on a killing spree, 15 years after murdering his sister. After a prison bus crashes, the killer is back in the wild, but survivor Laurie Strode is ready for his return. Director David Gordon Green's horror sequel based on John Carpenter's much imitated 1978 namesake movie, starring Jamie Lee Curtis, Judy Greer and Andi Matichak.

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: The Hangman's Daughter
programme.desc: Prequel to the acclaimed horror tale, in which a band of Western outlaws and unfortunate travellers stumble across a remote bar inhabited by suspicious looking characters _ who turn out to be vampires. Marco Leonardi, Michael Parks and Temuera Morrison star.

programme.title: Wolf Man
programme.desc: After a family barricade themselves inside their remote farmhouse when a creature attacks, a father slowly transforms into something unrecognisable. Werewolf horror from The Invisible Man director Leigh Whannell, starring Christopher Abbott, Julia Garner, Matilda Firth and Sam Jaeger.

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: Married musicians Daphne and Darcy Davenport moved from London to a cottage in Wales to complete their new album. By accident they record a mystical sound never heard before, and gradually disconnect from reality. Writer/director Bryn Chainey's horror, starring Dev Patel and Rosy McEwen.

programme.title: Night Patrol
programme.desc: An LA cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighbourhood in danger. Director Ryan Prows' horror thriller, starring Jermaine Fowler and Justin Long.

programme.title: Man Finds Tape
programme.desc: After finding mysterious video clips, siblings investigate the strange recordings and uncover a disturbing secret. Horror thriller, starring Kelsey Pribilski and William Magnuson.

programme.title: Beast of War
programme.desc: A group of soldiers get stranded on a raft in the middle of the ocean after their ship is sunk, and must battle a great white shark. Writer/director Kiah Roache-Turner's horror thriller, starring Mark Coles Smith and Joel Nankervis.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson.

programme.title: Bring Her Back
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Andy and his visually impaired younger stepsister Piper discover their father dead in the shower. Single mother Laura agrees to take in Andy and Piper until the traumatised youngster comes of age and can apply for legal guardianship of his stepsister. Hoever, when events inside Laura's home spiral out of control, Andy fears he is losing his mind. Thriller, starring Billy Barratt, Sora Wong and Sally Hawkins.

programme.desc: Cameron Cade is predicted to be the next great quarterback of American football. During a night-time training session, he suffers a traumatic brain injury. Cameron agrees to attend a week-long boot camp run by retiring star quarterback Isaiah White at his secluded desert compound. However, Cade's life soon turns into a nightmare. Supernatural horror, starring Marlon Wayans and Tyriq Withers.

programme.title: Billy Two Hats
programme.desc: After a bank robbery goes wrong, outlaw Billy Two Hats (Desi Arnaz Jr.) is captured by Sheriff Gifford (Jack Warden). Billy's partner, Arch Deans (Gregory Peck), rescues him, but during the escape Deans gets shot in the leg. The wound leaves Deans unable to ride a horse, but Billy refuses to leave him behind. Instead, he builds a horse-drawn cot for him, and they continue together. The apparatus slows them down, however, making them even more vulnerable to capture from the pursuing sheriff.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: Inspired by the Battle of the Little Bighorn, this Western follows a selfish military leader, Gen. Frederick McCabe (Andrew Duggan), who unfeelingly throws his soldiers into dangerous battle situations, and the soldiers who must follow his orders. While waiting to be sent into combat, two of the men -- Harrod (Tom Tryon) and Rogers (Harve Presnell) -- find themselves in the midst of a love triangle as they both pursue the heart of the beautiful Lou Woddard (Senta Berger).

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers
programme.desc: Set during the Civil War, Colonel John Marlowe leads a Union Calvary brigade on a mission behind Confederate lines to destroy enemy railroads and supplies. The colonel is confronted with numerous challenges before reaching Union held Baton Rouge.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Gunfight at Dodge City
programme.desc: Gambler and gunman Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rides into Dodge City, Kan., to visit his straight-arrow brother, Ed (Harry Lauter), who is hoping to defeat crooked sheriff Jim Regan (Don Haggerty) in an upcoming election. Bat purchases and renovates a rundown saloon, attracting the notice of Regan's henchmen. A shooting during the saloon's opening-night celebration causes Bat to pursue his own political vendetta against Regan and attempt to clean up the town's corruption once and for all.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Cast a Long Shadow
programme.desc: Chip (John Dehner), a ranch foreman, approaches aimless hard-drinker Matt Brown (Audie Murphy) in a New Mexico bar. The owner of Chip's ranch has died and left Matt his land, thinking the troubled drifter may be his long-estranged son. Initially, Matt plans on selling the ranch, but then decides to keep it, hoping to impress his ex-lover, Janet (Terry Moore). The ranch, however, turns out to be in foreclosure, forcing Matt and Chip to come up with a plan to pay off their debt to the bank.

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: An outlaw attempting to go straight while tracking down one of his wife's killers, Jim "Tex" Wall (George Montgomery) finds work on a ranch operated by disabled cattle owner "Bull" Herrick (Bruce Bennett). As Tex begins to fall for Bull's pretty sister, Helen (Sylvia Findley), he also has to face off against two feuding gangs of rustlers, one led by the tough Heesman (Peter Graves). Can Tex escape his shady past and finally end his mission of vengeance?

programme.title: The King and Four Queens
programme.desc: The four McDade brothers stage a successful heist -- except that three of them are killed. When their wives and mother learn that only one of the young men survived with the loot, they are eager to find out which one. Slick traveler Dan Kehoe catches wind of this strange situation and decides to charm the women in hopes of eventually enjoying the spoils. Before long, however, the lonely females begin competing for Dan, disintegrating into a cut-throat battle royal for his heart.

programme.title: Invitation to a Gunfighter
programme.desc: From worse to terrible -- Civil War veteran Matt Weaver (George Segal) arrives in New Mexico worn down from combat, only to discover his family plot has been requisitioned and sold by cutthroat property developer Sam Brewster. When Weaver attempts to reclaim his land, Brewster hires a reclusive gunman (Yul Brynner) to take him out. However, the gunman proves uncontrollable. He refuses to kill Weaver and instead tries to seduce his wife (Janice Rule), all the while wreaking havoc throughout town.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Return of the Seven
programme.desc: The residents of a Mexican village are intimidated by deranged rancher Lorca (Emilio Fernández), who assembles 50 gunmen to force the townspeople to construct a church in honor of his dead sons. Vigilante Chico (Julian Mateos), who previously teamed up with six other sharpshooters to protect the villagers in a time of need, learns of Lorca's harassment and decides to round up the old gang members, including Chris (Yul Brynner) and Vin (Robert Fuller), and ride in to save the town again.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Guns of the Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: When Quintero (Fernando Rey), a Mexican revolutionary leader, is left to rot in jail by the forces of President Diaz, it's up to his subordinate, Max (Reni Santoni), to bust him out. With $600 in hand, he crosses the border into America and hires Chris Adams (George Kennedy), a mercenary of considerable skill, who uses the rest of the cash on more hired guns. After the team is rounded out by experts on close-combat fighting, explosives and knife-throwing, they set off to free Quintero.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
programme.desc: Erstwhile gunslinger Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) has put his rowdy days behind him, settling down with a wife (Mariette Hartley) and serving as the sheriff of his town in the Arizona territory. So when his old pal Jim Mackay (Ralph Waite) asks for help defending the border town of Magdalena, Mexico, from a marauding bandit named De Toro, Chris refuses. It's only after De Toro's gang kidnaps Chris's wife that he changes his mind, enlisting a cutthroat gang of prisoners to help him.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Death Rides a Horse
programme.desc: Having witnessed the brutal murder of his entire family by bandits at the age of 5, Bill Meceita has spent 15 years planning his vengeance. Finding a kindred spirit in Ryan, an experienced gunslinger seeking his own revenge on those who framed him, the two team up to find and kill Walcott, a fearsome bandit on the loose. But Bill soon discovers that Ryan may know more about his tragic past than he has let on.

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.title: The Bigamist
programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

programme.title: Blue Valentine
programme.desc: Dean (Ryan Gosling) and Cindy (Michelle Williams) live a quiet life in a modest neighborhood. To the casual observer, everything appears normal, if a bit subdued. But a closer examination reveals a couple caught in a downward spiral. They appear to have the world at their feet at the outset of the relationship. However, his lack of ambition and her retreat into self-absorption cause potentially irreversible cracks in their marriage.

programme.title: Sliver
programme.desc: Well-to-do book editor Carly Norris (Sharon Stone) moves into a luxury apartment building before learning that a number of female tenants have been dying in grisly ways, allegedly at the hands of a serial killer. Soon, Norris becomes romantically involved with one of the prime suspects, building owner Zeke Hawkins (William Baldwin). The other suspect is her neighbor, writer Jack Landsford (Tom Berenger). Unsure of whom to trust, Norris must uncover the truth before she is the next victim.

programme.title: The Babysitter
programme.desc: Jennifer (Alicia Silverstone) is a lovely teen who has been hired to baby-sit the kids of Harry Tucker (J.T. Walsh) and his wife, Dolly (Lee Garlington). But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery.

programme.title: Case 39
programme.desc: In her many years as a social worker, Emily Jenkins (Renée Zellweger) thinks she has seen it all -- until she meets 10-year-old Lilith (Jodelle Ferland) and the girl's cruel parents. When the parents try to harm the child, Emily assumes custody of Lilith while looking for a foster family. However, she soon finds that dark forces surround the seemingly innocent child, and the more she tries to protect Lilith, the more horrors she encounters.

With Bill left for dead, Brad and corrupt lawyer Alton Small (Ted Adams) produce a forged will that disinherits Bill's teenage daughter, Robin (Shirley Patterson), and son Freckles (Johnny McGovern). Aid arrives in the form of cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), who help Robin fight for her rightful property.

programme.title: Don Ricardo Returns
programme.desc: Two years after being forcibly taken away from his California property by thugs working for his greedy cousin, Luerra (Anthony Warde), Don Ricardo (Fred Coby) returns to reclaim his ranch and his fiancée, Dorothea (Isabelita). After meeting old friend Lugo the Huge (Paul Newlan) in a cantina, Don Ricardo takes the advice of Padre Carlos (David Leonard) and gets a job on his land, disguised as a common laborer, biding his time until he can find evidence of Luerra's wrongdoing and challenge him.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Terror in a Texas Town
programme.desc: When Swedish-American whaler George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, he's shocked to learn that his father was murdered just two days prior. The feckless local sheriff won't do anything about it, so George investigates on his own and discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price. Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.desc: Young Cole Sear (Haley Joel Osment) is haunted by a dark secret: he is visited by ghosts. Cole is frightened by visitations from those with unresolved problems who appear from the shadows. He is too afraid to tell anyone about his anguish, except child psychologist Dr. Malcolm Crowe (Bruce Willis). programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Sue Thomas F.B.Eye
programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. When she is given the tedious task of analyzing fingerprints, Sue is disappointed but doesn't remain there for long. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. Suddenly, Sue and her hearing dog, Levi, are "G-Men," involved in a lot more action than they bargained for. This series is loosely based on the real-life deaf FBI agent Sue Thomas.

programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. programme.title: CBS Weekend News
programme.desc: Journalist Adriana Diaz anchors the Saturday edition of the CBS news program from Chicago, while Jericka Duncan takes the helm of the Sunday broadcast from New York. The program offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Brother, Can You Spare a Dime?
programme.desc: The Great Depression, in both its bleak lows and its artistic highs, is presented in this documentary. Featuring the grim reality that many Americans faced during the era, largely in the form of newsreel clips, the film also depicts how Hollywood dealt with this period of widespread poverty and unemployment. Much of the movie footage showcases glamour and extravagance, providing lively moments of escapism that contrast starkly with day-to-day life during the 1930s.

programme.title: The Man Who Skied Down Everest
programme.desc: This Oscar-winning documentary tells the story behind Japanese daredevil Yuichiro Miura's 1970 effort to ski down the world's tallest mountain. Miura's trek to the top of Everest provides much of the film's drama, as several members of his climbing team die in the process. The arduous trek gives way to footage of Miura's stunning descent, which requires him to use a parachute to control his speed. The action is supplemented by passages from the journal Miura kept during the adventure.

programme.title: Hot Bench
programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. After hearing each case, the judges discuss it among themselves before rendering a verdict. The jurists are experienced civil litigator Tanya Acker, New York State Supreme Court Justice Patricia DiMango, and former criminal defense attorney Larry Bakman. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions.

programme.title: Hot Bench
programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. After hearing each case, the judges discuss it among themselves before rendering a verdict. The jurists are experienced civil litigator Tanya Acker, New York State Supreme Court Justice Patricia DiMango, and former criminal defense attorney Larry Bakman. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions.

But, when it becomes clear that the attempted crime was part of a larger conspiracy, Eddie and Soapy must widen their investigation.

programme.title: Paradise Canyon

With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

programme.title: Frontier Fugitives

Apprised of the situation, Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) decide to outsmart the crook. Posing as a Native American, Panhandle sets in motion a clever plan aimed at ensnaring the bandits.

programme.title: The Lawless Frontier

John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

programme.title: The Navajo Kid

Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large.

programme.title: Texas Terror

Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

Walker is a proven performer in big-game billfish tournaments and has fished the waters of the Florida Keys and the Mid-Atlantic for more than 25 years. Together, in the search for yellowfin tuna, red snapper, sharks, sailfish, mahi-mahi or marlin, they demonstrate how to make an offshore fishing adventure a success.

programme.title: America's Black Forum
programme.desc: Political analyst Marc Morial hosts a weekly syndicated newsmagazine series featuring in-depth and engaging interviews with newsmakers, influencers, business entrepreneurs, artists, health and wellness experts and social justice leaders. Targeted to an African American audience, "America's Black Forum" was an hourlong production from 1977 to 2006. It has been revived as a 30-minute series after being off the air for 15 years, but has maintained the same format.

programme.title: Ice Age Giants
programme.desc: Journey back 40,000 years and discover the great beasts of the Ice Age with Professor Alice Roberts. Alice's Ice Age odyssey begins in the land of the Sabre-tooth, North America, a continent that was half-covered by ice, up to two miles thick. Yet, it also boasts the most impressive cast of Ice Age Giants in the world.

programme.title: Ice Age Giants
programme.desc: Alice ventures to the parts of the Northern Hemisphere, hit the hardest by the cold - Europe and Siberia. High in the mountains of Transylvania, a cave sealed for thousands of years reveals grisly evidence for a fight to the death between two starving giants, a cave bear and a cave lion. Yet Alice discovers that for woolly rhinos and woolly mammoths, the Ice Age created a bounty.

programme.title: Ice Age Giants
programme.desc: Even after thousands of years of ice crushing the Northern Hemisphere and temperatures of 20 degrees lower than those of today, many of the great giants of the Ice Age still walked the earth. It was only when the world had warmed up again that mammoths, woolly rhinos, sabre-toothed cats and giant ground sloths finally became extinct. Professor Alice Roberts sets off on her last voyage back to the Ice Age to discover why.

programme.title: Wildlife on One

programme.title: Walking with Monsters: Life Before Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Part 1/3. As life starts evolving in the oceans, our bizarre earliest ancestors battle against 3m long sea scorpions and giant carnivorous fish. Their ability to survive will determine the shape of life on Earth and whether humans will exist at all. As our amphibian ancestors struggle onto land the monsters they face are even more deadly.

programme.title: Walking with Monsters: Life Before Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Part 2/3. Millions of years before the dinosaurs, a world full of giant sabretooth reptiles and huge armoured herbivores was obliterated when global temperatures soared and vast deserts blanketed the land. As the environment recovered, populations of one species of tough reptile exploded until it alone dominated the planet, but its reign was short-lived.

programme.title: Walking with Monsters: Life Before Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Part 3/3. The struggle for survival moves onto land in the shape of early reptiles such as Petrolacosaurus. In the Carboniferous swamps, insects and arthropods have taken over and grown into giants, from the giant spider Mesothelae to millipede-like monsters. As the swamps dry up, the world becomes dominated by the first ever giant reptiles - the huge, sail-backed Edaphosaurus.

programme.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
programme.sub-title: Free Will, Love, and Divine Providence
programme.desc: Lesson 8 explores the relationship between free will, love, and divine providence, focusing on how God interacts with the world. Divine providence refers to God’s actions, but Christians have different views about the extent of His control. Some believe God determines all events, while others see biblical evidence that God allows human free will, even though it can lead to evil and suffering. God is all-powerful but does not force love or predetermine individual fates. The lesson emphasizes that, despite suffering, believers can take comfort in Jesus’ victory over the world and trust in God’s ultimate plan for good.

programme.title: Awesome Science
programme.desc: Noah explores The Mammoth Site in Hot Springs, South Dakota. He’ll explore this amazing site, where over one hundred mammoths have been preserved in the sediments in an ancient sinkhole. He’ll find out how genetics can explain where the mammoths came from after the global Flood, why radio carbon dating can only give us accurate dates of a few thousand years, and how they could have reproduced so quickly after coming off the ark. Finally, he’ll explore how the Ice Age, caused by the global Flood, would have come and gone quickly, causing the right conditions to force the mammoths into extinction.

programme.title: 3ABN Hoy
programme.sub-title: Testimonio personal del Pr. José Feliciano Castillo Lugo
programme.desc: En esta inspiradora entrevista, el Pastor José Feliciano Castillo Lugo comparte profundamente su testimonio personal. Inicia relatando su infancia en Castaños, Coahuila (México), marcada por el alcoholismo de su padre. Sin embargo, tras “un último trago”, su padre decidió darle una oportunidad a Cristo. Este paso lo llevó a la Iglesia Adventista del Séptimo Día local, donde se bautizó y experimentó una transformación total, convirtiéndose en un ejemplo de rectitud para su familia. El Pr. Castillo continúa narrando su etapa como universitario, un periodo lleno de adversidades, frustraciones y desafíos. A pesar de ello, afirma que Dios lo sostuvo y lo ayudó a superar cada obstáculo. En ese proceso, Dios le mostró los “caminos torcidos” en los que viví a, y él tomó la decisión de enderezar sus pasos para honrar a Dios. Esta experiencia de cambio lo llevó finalmente al ministerio. Después de servir como oficial en México, hoy es evangelista y pastor en el estado de Tennessee, donde continúa compartiendo el mensaje de esperanza. Está casado con KeSardis, quien lo acompaña en el ministerio, y juntos crían a sus tres hijas. La entrevista es un testimonio poderoso de cómo Dios transforma vidas y abre nuevos comienzos. Para más historias de transformación y una amplia programación cristiana, puede descargar gratuitamente la aplicación 3ABN+ y suscribirse al canal 3ABN Latino en YouTube.

programme.title: Hiring America
programme.desc: Upon returning home from active duty, it can be difficult for veterans to transition into civilian life. "Hiring America" tries to make it a little easier by showcasing companies that have jobs available for current and former members of the armed forces. In addition to the career opportunities, the show welcomes career counselors and HR specialists who provide tips to help the military members ease back into the civilian workforce. The show also features organizations that provide services to help facilitate the transition process. Gigi Stone Woods hosts the half-hour show.

programme.title: Small Town Big Deal
programme.desc: To put a spin on a popular saying about Las Vegas, what happens in a small town stays in a small town. That's because small cities and towns across America often get lost in the mainstream media that focuses on major metropolitan areas like New York and Los Angeles. "Small Town Big Deal" tries to change that by telling the stories of innovation, tradition and success that are happening in rural places. Episodes cover small-town residents having an impact on others through their actions and notable businesses, including the Frankenmuth, Mich., retail store that is considered the world's largest Christmas store.

programme.title: Street Magic
programme.desc: Troy Von Scheibner first became interested in magic at the age of 12, practiced the art through various odd jobs throughout childhood and college, and now is one of the most popular magicians in England. This reality series shows what happens when the performer hits the streets of London to showcase his close-up magic and stunts for unsuspecting locals and tourists. Von Scheibner takes advantage of his surroundings by drawing inspiration from the city's landmarks while integrating them into some of his illusions, such as teleporting across Tower Bridge. Some of Troy's tricks are more restrained, though, like when he uses his talents to help passengers get off of a bus.

programme.title: Jeanne Eagels
programme.desc: In this biopic, waitress Jeanne Eagels (Kim Novak) is desperate for fame and joins the carnival to try to achieve it. Under the watchful eye of impresario Sal Satori (Jeff Chandler), Eagels becomes a dancer -- a position that eventually brings her to New York City. With her heart set on filling a Broadway marquee with her name, Eagels takes acting lessons and earns a job as an understudy for a big production. But what she really wants is the starring role -- and she'll hurt anyone to get it.

programme.title: You Belong to Me
programme.desc: Rich playboy Peter Kirk (Henry Fonda) crashes into Dr. Helen Hunt (Barbara Stanwyck) on a ski slope and overplays his injuries so she will continue her medical attention. He declares his love, and, although Helen insists that her career will always come first, the two get married. Soon, Peter is consumed by jealous suspicions of his wife's male patients and embarrasses Helen several times. Fearful of driving her away, Peter launches into character-changing behavior to prove his love.

programme.title: Under the Yum Yum Tree
programme.desc: Libidinous Hogan (Jack Lemmon) is a landlord who prefers to rent his rooms to attractive single females. Hogan is instantly smitten with a pretty new tenant named Robin (Carol Lynley), but realizes that he'll have to contend with Robin's boyfriend, David (Dean Jones), if he's to attain the object of his desire. He gets his opportunity when he learns that the couple's living arrangement is a pre-marital experiment to see if they would be compatible as partners when sex is out of the equation.

programme.title: It Should Happen to You

By the end of this series, you will recognize and be able to refute the major Davidian doctrines such as Ezekiel 9, the stone of Daniel 2, and the pre-millennial kingdom, as well as their commonly used Bible and Spirit of Prophecy references. Ephesians 6:11-19 tells us to put on the whole armor of God that you may be able to stand firm no matter what evil the devil sends your way. False prophets shall arise (Matt 24:11) and false theories, clothed with garments of light, will be presented to God's people… seducing influences exerted; minds hypnotized (Maranatha, Feb 20, "Beware of Satan's Agents", p.59:1). There are grievous wolves in our mists, men speaking perverse things, drawing away disciples after them (Acts 20:29-30). BEWARE! Take heed that no man deceive you (Matt 24:4). "God will arouse His people, if other means fail, heresies will come in among them...We should present sound arguments that will not only silence our opponents, but will bear the closest and most searching scrutiny.. ." (5T, 707:3 - 709). Search the Scriptures and the Spirit of Prophecy by the grace of the Holy Spirit. The speaker has done just this. Praise God! Through His miracle, Ismael was brought out of the Shepherd's Rod deception. Finally, through this series, it is time to set the record straight.

Esta serie es el resultado de años de investigación. Al aplicar estos 15 principios, usted mismo podrá entender y exponer las profecías con claridad y poder.
